subject: Governance panel alignment and legal route
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Nguyen <tim.nguyen@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up + proposed governance panel slot and next procurement steps

Hi Tim — great conversation today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have alignment before you loop in legal/procurement:

- Goal: get governance panel comfortable with our security posture and commercial model, then move to procurement for an MSA + capacity commit.
- Decision criteria you called out: data residency controls, audit logging retention, incident response SLA, and predictable unit economics for burst-heavy workloads.

Proposed immediate items:
1) Schedule a 45-min governance panel slot (we can run a 20-min demo + 20-min Q&A + decision checklist).
2) Share a one-page commercial playbook and a targeted security artifact pack for your reviewers.
3) Confirm procurement timeline & who will sign (economic buyer + procurement rep).

I attached a short commercial playbook and a draft agenda for the governance meeting. If you can share preferred times next week (PST window works for us), I’ll lock the invite and include our security lead Marissa and Karthik (sales engineering) for the deep dive.

Attachments: Redwood-commercial-playbook-v2.pdf; Acme-governance-agenda-draft.docx

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Tim Nguyen <tim.nguyen@acmecloud.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecloud.com>, Bryce Hall <bryce.hall@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up + proposed governance panel slot and next procurement steps

Thanks Rafael — that recap looks right. A few clarifications from our side:

- Procurement: Priya (cc’d) will lead the procurement process. She’ll need your standard MSA + SOW and an initial estimate of committed spend for Dedicated capacity.
- Legal: Bryce (cc’d) wants to see SOC2 evidence and a sample Data Processing Addendum.
- Timeline: governance panel next Tue (Dec 1) or Thu (Dec 3) early afternoon PT would be ideal. We aim to have procurement review complete by Dec 17.

Action items for Redwood:
- Send MSA + SOW template + DPA sample.
- Provide SOC2 report or summary and retention policy for audit logs.
- Confirm that the demo will include a short walkthrough of KV-cache behavior and latency under burst.

If you can route the legal artifacts via DocuSign, that’s easiest for our procurement team.

—Tim
Tim Nguyen | Head of Platform Engineering | Acme Cloud
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Nguyen <tim.nguyen@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecloud.com>, Bryce Hall <bryce.hall@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up + proposed governance panel slot and next procurement steps

Tim — appreciate the clarity. Quick replies to your asks and next steps:

- MSA/DPA/SOC2: attaching our standard MSA stub and a SOC 2 summary deck. I’ll also send the DPA template and SOC2 PDF to Bryce via DocuSign link (see related links).
- Committed spend: for a conservative planning number, we propose a 6-month pilot with a reserved pool equivalent to 4 x A100 for predictable burst capacity; I included a short cost estimate in the commercial playbook. We can tighten numbers after the workload psych review.
- Demo scope: yes — we’ll include a 10–12 minute KV cache & burst demo with latency graphs and the autoscaling policy behavior. Marissa will run that portion.

Proposed governance panel times (PT):
- Tue, Dec 1 — 1:30–2:15pm PT
- Thu, Dec 3 — 11:00–11:45am PT

Can you confirm preferred slot and list of attendees we should expect from Acme (titles help so we bring the right level of detail)?

Attachments: Redwood-commercial-playbook-v2.pdf; Redwood-MSA-stub.pdf; SOC2-summary.pdf

Best,
Rafael
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:24:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Governance panel alignment and legal route (internal prep)

Team — prepping the deck and runbook for the panel. Notes for the slide set and who presents:

- Slide 3 (security artifacts): Marissa — SOC2 summary + DPA highlights (2 slides)
- Live demo (Marissa + Karthik): KV cache demo and burst behavior (12 min) — Karthik will control the demo environment; I’ll have latency charts ready.
- Commercial ask slide (Rafael): committed pilot sizing and pricing bands (1 slide)
- Decision checklist (Lauren): explicit approval criteria we need from the panel (data residency, logging, SLA exceptions, procurement approval).

Prep items:
- Karthik to produce a 3-minute recording of the KV-cache demo risks and fallback modes by EOD (for review).
- Monica to draft the one-page decision checklist bullet points and share with Rafael and Lauren.

I’ll assemble a single PDF with notes and rehearsal bullets and drop it in the shared drive link (will paste link here once generated).

—Marissa
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecloud.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Tim Nguyen <tim.nguyen@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Bryce Hall <bryce.hall@acmecloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up + proposed governance panel slot and next procurement steps

Rafael — Thu Dec 3, 11:00–11:45am PT works for the governance panel. Attendee list from Acme:
- Tim Nguyen (Head of Platform Engineering)
- Priya Shah (Procurement lead)
- Bryce Hall (Legal)
- Alina Torres (Director, InfoSec)

Procurement asks before the meeting: please upload the MSA stub + DPA and SOC2 summary to DocuSign/shared folder. We also need the initial high-level estimate for committed spend (the playbook number is fine for now). After the panel, if all looks good, our procurement lead will route the standard MSA redline and aim to complete review by Dec 17.

DocuSign link (sample MSA for signature routing): https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abcdef123456

Thanks — Priya
Priya Shah | Strategic Procurement | Acme Cloud
